stem: Draw the graph of $f(x) = {=a}x - {=n}$ by finding ordered pairs. At which point does the line cross the $x$-axis? Write it as $(x, y)$.
solution: Find ordered pairs: $f(0) = {=y1}$, so $(0, {=y1})$ is on the line; $f({=x0}) = {=a} \times {=x0} - {=n} = 0$, so $({=x0}, 0)$ is on the line.
